column3: 画面内容
卧室内，Theo拉过一把椅子，Iris躺在床上，表情很苍白
Theo坐在Iris的床前，严肃地说
column8: Theo (serious): Iris. I need to talk to you straight.

column3: Theo对着Iris，严肃地说
column8: Theo (serious): Iris. I need to talk to you straight.

column3: Iris只是默默地点了点头，脸色很难看
Theo叹了一口气，说
column8: Theo (cont.): You're getting worse, Iris. I've done everything I can do here — this is out of my hands now. You need a real hospital.

column3: Iris虽然病态但是还是坚定地说
column8: Iris (calm, as if she expected this): I'm not going.

column3: Theo看向一旁，摇了摇头，又看向Iris，坚定轻声说
column8: Theo (one word at a time): If you don't go to a hospital, you will die. Can you live with leaving Luna an orphan?

column3: Iris不再看Theo，她只是闭上眼，一滴泪从她眼角渗了出来
闪回，6年前，同样的房间，简陋，一张床，一盏破旧的吊灯，Iris躺在床上，肚子高高隆起，痛苦的样子
身边的心电监护仪心率骤降，发出警报，Iris的肚子高高隆起，镜头摇向脸部，Iris的脸色惨白，嘴角有血迹，她用手捂住嘴，咳嗽，
Theo站在床边，看向监护仪，又看向Iris，眉头紧锁，着急地说：
column8: Theo (urgent): You need to go to a hospital — the way you are right now —

column3: Iris把手拿开，手里有渗出的血迹，她强忍着痛苦说
column8: Iris (weak but firm, shaking her head): I can't. I can't be found.

column3: Theo焦急地说
column8: Theo (low, trying to reason): No one is going to find you —

column3: Iris虚弱地说，但是语气充满坚定
column8: Iris (cutting him off, very quiet — a line that cannot be crossed): This is my principle. I cannot go to a hospital.

column3: Theo皱着眉头，又诧异又没办法，
Irs看了看Theo，流出了泪，把手放到了自己的肚子上，从脸摇到肚子
column8: Iris (tears streaming, very soft): I can feel it... my baby is protecting me.

column3: 手摸着肚子特写
心率慢慢稳定了下来
Theo看了看心电检测仪，惊讶，又看向Iris
Iris躺在床上，表情变得平静，泪水从眼角滑落
闪回结束，Iris睁开眼，看着天花板
column8: Iris (V.O.): I've been hiding for six years. Maybe Caius has long forgotten I exist. And besides — he already got what he needed from me. As long as he's alive, he probably won't come after me.

column3: Iris抬头看向Theo，平静缓慢地说
column8: Iris (eyes red, voice rough — but steady): You're right.

column3: Theo还是皱着眉，担忧的样子
Iris坚定地说
column8: Iris (cont., one word at a time): I'm a mother. I need to live — for Luna.

column3: Iris深吸一口气，说
column8: Iris (cont.): I'll go to the hospital.

column3: Theo看着她，欣慰地点了点头，眼眶发红，转身拿起手机，点着什么
小镇上，多个地点快切，几个西装小弟走进医院大厅
药房的门口，西装小弟守在门口
几个西装小弟下车，守住了小镇的路口
咖啡馆旁走过几个张望的小弟
Dante站在街边，身后跟着几个小弟，手里拿着对讲机，严厉地说
column8: Dante (into the walkie-talkie): The entire town. Not a single corner gets missed.
